correctness.rationale: Exact coefficient-level formulas (1)-(2) follow from binomial expansion and ℓ1 matrix column norm. The difference formula includes the shifted binomial mass with correct signs and terminal coefficient. Uniform binomial local CLT plus ratio identity and subgaussian tails yield the derivative kernel. For 0<alpha<1, singular Riemann sums are uniformly integrable, and the separate small/large column arguments ensure global supremum convergence. Positive ACB follows from exact negative-binomial renewal sum; spectral disk follows from eigenvectors and spectral mapping. The two sharp constants are positive maxima, proved by Gaussian tails. Finite numerical diagnostics are ancillary; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem computes two nontrivial natural dynamical norm invariants with exact constants for a single positive absolutely Cesàro bounded but non-power-bounded operator family with singleton peripheral spectrum. It separates divergent power norms from decaying first differences and reveals precise complementary alpha/2 and (1-alpha)/2 exponents. These sharp quantitative invariants fill the natural analytic gap between general ACB growth results and the 2026 positive KT question; this is not a renaming or cheap exercise.
